content.text: Edge-case 1: Repo with empty/null name** — In
`buildRepoRow`, `nameLink.textContent = repo
.name || '—'`. If `repo.name` is `null` or `''`, the link displays `'—'` grac
efully. The `href` is still correct because it uses `repo.id`, not `

repo.name`. ✅

**Edge-case 2: Repo ID containing `%` characters (double-encoding
risk)** — `encodeURIComponent` encodes `%` → `%25`. The router decodes with `decodeURIComponent`,
yielding the original `%` back to `renderRepositoryDetail`. No
double-encoding problem because the href is set from `repo.id` (raw

), not from an already-encoded value. ✅

**Edge-case 3: Pattern shad
owing by `#/repositories` vs `#/repositories/:
id`** — The `#/repositories` regex compiles to `^#\/repositories$` (exact match). It will only match exactly
`#/repositories` and not `#/repositories/my-repo`. The `:id` route uses `([^/]+)` which requires

at least one non-slash character, so it won't match bare `#/repositories/`. No shadowing. ✅

**Edge-case 4: `
nameLink.hidden` state when save fails** — In the
`saveBtn` click handler (line 162–186), if the API call throws
, the `finally` block only re-enables the button — it does
NOT switch back to read mode. The input remains visible, which is

the correct UX (user keeps their unsaved input). ✅
